verses.arabic: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.english: Suad. By the Quran bearing the Reminder,
verses.transliteration_html: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri
verses.transliteration_text: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
verses.english: the faithless indeed dwell in conceit and defiance.
verses.transliteration_html: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin
verses.transliteration_text: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin

verses.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
verses.english: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! They cried out [for help], but gone was the time for escape.
verses.transliteration_html: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin
verses.transliteration_text: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin

verses.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
verses.english: They consider it odd that there should come to them a warner from among themselves, and the faithless say, ‘This is a magician, a mendacious liar.’
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun

verses.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
verses.english: ‘Has he reduced the gods to one god? This is indeed an odd thing!’
verses.transliteration_html: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun
verses.transliteration_text: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun

verses.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
verses.english: Their elite go about [urging others]: ‘Go and stand by your gods! This is indeed the desirable thing [to do].
verses.transliteration_html: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu
verses.transliteration_text: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu

verses.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
verses.english: We did not hear of this in the latter-day creed. This is nothing but a fabrication.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun
verses.transliteration_text: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

verses.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.english: Has the Reminder been sent down to him out of [all of] us?’ Indeed, they are in doubt concerning My Reminder. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
verses.transliteration_html: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi
verses.transliteration_text: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.english: Do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-mighty, the All-munificent?
verses.transliteration_html: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi
verses.transliteration_text: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
verses.english: Do they own the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? [If so,] let them ascend [to the higher spheres] by the means [of ascension].
verses.transliteration_html: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi
verses.transliteration_text: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi

verses.arabic: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.english: [They are but] a host routed out there of the factions.
verses.transliteration_html: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi
verses.transliteration_text: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.english: Before them Noah’s people impugned [their apostle] and [so did the people of] ‘Ad, and Pharaoh, the Impaler [of his victims],
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.english: and Thamud, and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Aykah: those were the factions.
verses.transliteration_html: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu
verses.transliteration_text: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu

verses.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.english: There was not any one but such as impugned the apostles; so My retribution became due [against them].
verses.transliteration_html: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi
verses.transliteration_text: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
verses.english: These [too] do not await but a single Cry, which will not grant [them] any respite.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.english: They say, ‘Our Lord! Hasten on for us our share before the Day of Reckoning.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi

verses.arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.english: Be patient over what they say, and remember Our servant, David, [the man] of strength. Indeed he was a penitent [soul].
verses.transliteration_html: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun
verses.transliteration_text: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.english: We disposed the mountains to glorify [Allah] with him at evening and dawn,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi
verses.transliteration_text: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi

verses.arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.english: and the birds [as well], mustered [in flocks]; all echoing him [in a chorus].
verses.transliteration_html: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun
verses.transliteration_text: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun

verses.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.english: We consolidated his kingdom and gave him wisdom and conclusive speech.
verses.transliteration_html: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi
verses.transliteration_text: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi

verses.arabic: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.english: Has there not come to you the account of the contenders, when they scaled the wall into the sanctuary?
verses.transliteration_html: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba
verses.transliteration_text: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.english: When they entered into the presence of David, he was alarmed by them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid. [We are only] two contenders: one of us has bullied the other. So judge justly between us, and do not exceed [the bounds of justice], and show us the right path.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati
verses.transliteration_text: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.english: ‘This brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, while I have only a single ewe, and [yet] he says, ‘Commit it to my care,’ and he browbeats me in speech.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.english: He said, ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking your ewe in addition to his own ewes, and indeed many partners bully one another, except such as have faith and do righteous deeds, and few are they.’ Then David knew that We had tested him, whereat he pleaded with his Lord for forgiveness, and fell down in prostration and repented.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba
verses.transliteration_text: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba

verses.arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.english: So We forgave him that, and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.
verses.transliteration_html: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
verses.transliteration_text: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

verses.arabic: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.english: ‘O David! Indeed, We have made you a vicegerent on the earth. So judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires, or they will lead you astray from the way of Allah. Indeed there is a severe punishment for those who stray from the way of Allah, because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi
verses.transliteration_text: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.english: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is a conjecture of the faithless. So woe to the faithless for the Fire!
verses.transliteration_html: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari
verses.transliteration_text: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari

verses.arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.english: Shall We treat those who have faith and do righteous deeds like those who cause corruption on the earth? Shall We treat the Godwary like the vicious?
verses.transliteration_html: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari
verses.transliteration_text: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari

verses.arabic: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.english: [This is] a blessed Book that We have sent down to you, so that they may contemplate its signs, and that those who possess intellect may take admonition.
verses.transliteration_html: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi
verses.transliteration_text: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.english: And to David We gave Solomon—what an excellent servant he was! Indeed, he was a penitent [soul].
verses.transliteration_html: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
verses.transliteration_text: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.english: One evening when there were displayed before him prancing steeds,
verses.transliteration_html: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu
verses.transliteration_text: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.english: he said, ‘Indeed I have preferred the love of [worldly] niceties to the remembrance of my Lord until [the sun] disappeared behind the [night’s] veil.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi
verses.transliteration_text: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi

verses.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.english: ‘Bring it back for me!’ Then he [and others] began to wipe [their] legs and necks.
verses.transliteration_html: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi
verses.transliteration_text: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.english: Certainly We tried Solomon, and cast a [lifeless] body on his throne. Thereupon he was penitent.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom that will not befit anyone except me. Indeed You are the All-munificent.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu

verses.arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.english: So We disposed the wind for him, blowing softly wherever he intended by his command,
verses.transliteration_html: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba
verses.transliteration_text: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
verses.english: and every builder and diver from the demons,
verses.transliteration_html: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin
verses.transliteration_text: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.english: and others [too] bound together in chains.
verses.transliteration_html: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi
verses.transliteration_text: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.english: ‘This is Our bounty: so withhold or bestow without any reckoning.’
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.english: And remember Our servant Job [in the Quran]. When he called out to his Lord, ‘The devil has visited on me hardship and torment,’
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin

verses.arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verses.english: [We told him:] ‘Stamp your foot on the ground; this [ensuing spring] will be a cooling bath and drink.’
verses.transliteration_html: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun
verses.transliteration_text: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.english: We gave [back] his family to him along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for those who possess intellect.
verses.transliteration_html: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi
verses.transliteration_text: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi

verses.arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.english: [We told him:] ‘Take a faggot in your hand and then strike [your wife] with it, but do not break [your] oath.’ Indeed, We found him to be patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul].
verses.transliteration_html: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
verses.transliteration_text: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.english: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.english: Indeed We purified them with exclusive remembrance of the abode [of the Hereafter].
verses.transliteration_html: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari
verses.transliteration_text: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.english: Indeed they are surely with Us among the elect of the best.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.english: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhu’l-Kifl—each [of whom was] among the elect.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.english: This is a Reminder, and indeed the Godwary have a good destination:
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin

verses.arabic: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.english: the Gardens of Eden, whose gates will be flung open for them.
verses.transliteration_html: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu
verses.transliteration_text: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
verses.english: Reclining therein [on couches], they will call for abundant fruits and drinks,
verses.transliteration_html: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin
verses.transliteration_text: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin

verses.arabic: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.english: and there will be with them maidens of restrained glances, of a like age.
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.english: This is what you are promised on the Day of Reckoning.
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.english: This is Our provision, which will never be exhausted.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.english: This [will be for the righteous], and as for the rebellious there will surely be a bad destination:
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin

verses.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.english: hell, which they shall enter, an evil resting place.
verses.transliteration_html: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu
verses.transliteration_text: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
verses.english: [They will be told, ‘This is scalding water and pus; let them taste it,
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.english: and other kinds [of torments] resembling it.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun
verses.transliteration_text: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.english: [The leaders of the faithless will be told,] ‘This is a group [of your followers] plunging [into hell] along with you.’ [They will repond,] ‘May wretchedness be their lot! For they will enter the Fire.’
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.english: They will say, ‘No, may wretchedness be your lot! You prepared this [hell] for us. What an evil abode!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.english: They will say, ‘Our Lord! Whoever has prepared this for us, double his punishment in the Fire!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.english: And they will say, ‘Why is it that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count among the bad ones,
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari

verses.arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.english: ridiculing them, or do [our] eyes miss them [here]?’
verses.transliteration_html: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru
verses.transliteration_text: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.english: That is indeed a true account of the contentions of the inmates of the Fire.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari
verses.transliteration_text: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.english: Say, ‘I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the All-paramount,
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

verses.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.english: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.english: Say, ‘It is a great prophesy,
verses.transliteration_html: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: of which you are disregardful.
verses.transliteration_html: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.english: I have no knowledge of the Supernal Elite when they contend.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona

verses.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a manifest warner.’
verses.transliteration_html: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.english: When your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay.
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.english: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.english: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,
verses.transliteration_html: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.english: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and he was one of the faithless.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘O Iblis! What keeps you from prostrating before that which I have created with My [own] two hands? Are you arrogant, or are you one of the exalted ones?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
verses.english: ‘I am better than him,’ he said. ‘You created me from fire and You created him from clay.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.english: He said, ‘Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,
verses.transliteration_html: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.english: and indeed My curse will be on you till the Day of Retribution.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.english: Said He, ‘You are indeed among the reprieved
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.english: until the day of the known time.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
verses.transliteration_text: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘By Your might, I will surely pervert them,
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.english: except Your exclusive servants among them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.english: Said He, ‘The truth is that—and I speak the truth—
verses.transliteration_html: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu

verses.arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: I will surely fill hell with you and all those who follow you.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.english: Say, ‘I do not ask you any reward for it, and I am no impostor.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: It is just a reminder for all the nations,
verses.transliteration_html: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.english: and you will surely learn its tidings in due time.’
verses.transliteration_html: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin
verses.transliteration_text: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin
